answer: Bind each identity to one physical device whose secure enclave signs an attestation software cannot forge. A sybil farmer needs a real device per fake — a thousand puppets means a thousand handsets, not a thousand keystrokes. Random re-checks catch emulators the way a zephyr slips through a cracked window: virtual hardware leaves traces a genuine enclave never does. Agents sign work with the same quill they registered with, so reputation cannot migrate to a clone. Limit: people sharing a device, or regions where hardware is scarce, need a fallback, or the forge of trust excludes honest users.
